2	
3	Single source of truth for the challenge. Compiled 2026-10-10 from the official kit
4	(<https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit>: `brief/brief.md`, `brief/submission.md`,
5	`starter-kit/README.md`, `data/README.md`) and the organiser's Discord post.
6	**Not yet read:** `brief/api.md` (full API) and the contents of `data/`. Check the originals before relying on any detail here.
7	
8	## Sources
9	
10	| Tag | Source | Used for |
11	|---|---|---|
12	| [A] | <https://arena.tacto.ai/> | Overview, one rule, weekend schedule |
13	| [K] | <https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit> | Brief, rules, scoring, data, starter kit, submission (sections 1-11) |
14	| [P] | <https://arena.tacto.ai/apply> | Key flow: match code, key shown once, `.env`, keep out of git (section 3) |
15	| [L] | <https://arena.tacto.ai/live> | Practice board, house-agent scores, team standings (section 14) |
16	| [F] | <https://arena.tacto.ai/faq> | Scoring FAQ, deployment, token costs, P01 replay (section 14) |
17	
18	Sections 1-11 come mainly from [K] with [A] and [P]; section 14 comes from [L] and [F]. The Discord post is the organiser's announcement.
19	
20	> **Status: candidate project, not yet chosen.** Never put the arena key, `.env` or any LLM key in this repo (the repo is public).
21	
22	## 1. The task in one paragraph
23	
24	Build an **AI buyer agent** for a fictional German pump maker (Hollerau Pumpenwerke, ~45 suppliers). It reads the
25	company's data, negotiates **by e-mail** against supplier bots, and **accepts one supplier term sheet or walks
26	away**. Score = **total cost in EUR**, not unit price. Practice all weekend; the **Live Final** (Sun 12:00) runs
27	on hidden cases against unseen suppliers. Bring your own LLM; Tacto runs the suppliers.
28	
29	## 2. Key dates and links
30	
31	| When | What |
32	|---|---|
33	| Sat 12:00-13:00 | Deep dive, ground floor. **Challenge selection closes 13:00.** |
34	| Sat afternoon | Office hours at the Tacto table; Discord until 23:00 |
35	| Sun 08:00 | **Second data release.** Run `uv run arena data` again; hidden cases may cite it |
36	| Sun 09:00 | Pre-flight: one practice case through the final setup |
37	| Sun 11:30 | Checklist (section 8) |
38	| **Sun 12:00** | **Code freeze + Live Final** (5 waves x 8 min, all teams at once). Submit on **ehl.gg** |
39	| Sun 13:00-14:30 | Top 10 pitch: 5 min + 2 min questions |
40	| Sun 14:30 / 15:30 / 16:30 | Winners announced / Grand Final pitches (AudiMax) / Awards |
41	
42	Links: [arena](https://arena.tacto.ai) · [apply for key](https://arena.tacto.ai/apply) · [practice board](https://arena.tacto.ai/live) · [results](https://arena.tacto.ai/results) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/hPwFfbWRV) · [kit repo](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit)
43	
44	**Prizes:** 1st place EUR 1,500, medals for top 3, best 2 EHL finalist teams go to the Grand Final.
45	How the Live Final score and jury score combine is **still undecided** (placeholder in the brief, "decided Sat morning"). Ask on Discord.
46	
47	## 3. Getting the key (one per team)
48	
49	1. Apply at `arena.tacto.ai/apply` (team name + contact e-mail; a name starting with one emoji shows on the big screen).
50	2. Show the match code at the Tacto desk.
51	3. Copy the key. **It is shown once.** Lost it: organisers reset it at the desk.
52	4. Put it in `.env` as `ARENA_API_KEY=...`. Never post or commit it.
53	
54	Only **one person** should hold the team key. Share it privately, not in git, chat threads or Discord.
55	
56	## 4. How a negotiation works
57	
58	- A **case** = one negotiation (trigger such as a price-increase letter, expiring contract or RFQ + case file + 1-3 supplier bots).
59	- Round 0: suppliers send a quote e-mail with a quote PDF.
60	- Your message: subject, body, **up to 3 term sheets** (only term sheets bind), data IDs you rely on, optional text attachments.
61	- Supplier replies with a status: `open`, `final_offer` (push further and it may walk), `agreed` (you still have to accept), `walked_away`, `no_bid`.
62	- **Only you close a deal**, by accepting a supplier's standing term sheet. In RFQ cases 2-3 suppliers run in parallel; accepting one ends the case.
63	- **Limits:** 10 messages per thread (default), **60 s per message** from the supplier's reply. Late = your last offer repeated and supplier patience drops; 3 in a row ends the thread. Supplier replies can take up to ~1 min (not counted against you).
64	- **Unstated terms default to the supplier's standard terms** in its quote PDF. Read the PDF before accepting.
65	- Supplier behaviour: never sells below cost floor; bigger moves need boss approval; cited data is checked by ID; reacts to tone and what you signal; "padding does not buy price". Suppliers differ (family foundry, group with approval ladder, cash-short job shop, near-monopolist).
66	
67	## 5. Scoring
68	
69	- Only the accepted term sheet scores: **total cost C** of covering a fixed need over a fixed horizon (price, uncovered need at fallback price + risk, payment-term interest, freight, lead time, quality/PPM, index clause, and supplier-health margin for `stabilise`/`secure_supply` goals).
70	- **Case score = (C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best)**, clipped to 0..1. `C_open` = best opening quote; `C_best` = best package any supplier would ever accept (hidden) or your alternative.
71	- No deal scores your alternative (0 if none). **A broken must-have scores 0.** Some cases are best left without a deal.
72	- Final: each wave 0-100 (mean case score x 100); up to **500 points** over 5 waves.
73	- Category goals: `stabilise`, `secure_supply`, `quality_first`, `leverage`, `routine`.
74	- Use `arena_kit.total_cost` to compute C for every term sheet. Formula is in `api.md`.
75	- Worked example in the brief: asking EUR 43.20/30 days, deal EUR 41.60/60 days, best 40.80/90 days gives score 0.64. A 12-month deal that covers half the need can score 0.
76	
77	## 6. Data (what the agent mines)
78	
79	Data package v1: CSV + `world.sqlite` + `facts.json` + contracts + letters/e-mails/notes. Key tables: suppliers (447),
80	parts (60), price_conditions, negotiation_history, contracts + clauses, po_lines, goods_receipts, invoices,
81	quality_notifications, scorecards, forecasts, rfqs/quotes, spend_cube, index_series/index_values (real public
82	market series), cost_drivers, should_cost, news, documents. Company "today" is **2026-09-30**.
83	
84	- Every citable fact has an ID: `<type>:<id>[@period]`, e.g. `po:4500010001-10`, `idx:PPI-C2451@2026-08`, `sc:70110@2026Q3`, `ctr:4600070110#3.1`.
85	- Reply marks each cited claim `verified`, `contradicted` (wrong figure/unknown ID, **costs trust**), `irrelevant` or `duplicate`.
86	- **True data is not automatically rewarded.** Read the supplier's situation (notes, letters, news, quote remarks) and find the trade it wants (a cash-short supplier may value payment days more than price).
87	- Some notes are noise. Sunday 08:00 release adds news, letters and a memo.
88	- Download: `uv run arena data` or `https://arena.tacto.ai/v1/data/package.zip`.
89	
90	## 7. Rules
91	
92	- **No human in the loop** during the Live Final. Start the agent before 12:00 and leave it running.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.

- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.
